blocks.html: RLC Residences’ Woodsville Crest was recognized as Asia’s Best Smart Home Development for its safety, connectivity, and security home features at the recently held PropertyGuru Asia Property Awards Grand Final at Bangkok, Thailand last December 8, 2023.

Located in Merville, Parañaque City, the property is a nature-inspired condominium development that offers breathable living spaces equipped with smart home deliverables such as Smart Lock, Smart Lights, Audio-Video Intercom, and fiber optic technology among others. All these and more make the property a sound investment for real estate buyers and investors, with its first two towers almost sold out since its launch in November 2021.

“To be recognized as one of the best among Asia is such a huge honor for us at RLC Residences. Woodsville Crest is one of our most awarded projects and is one of the favorites of our investors thanks to its features, location, and even flexible payment terms. We couldn’t be more proud of this development with all the offerings it has and how it’s designed with the needs and lifestyle of our sanctuary seekers. We dedicate this win to our team and future residents of this property for making this happen,” says RLC Residences AVP and Head of Business Development and Design Stephanie Anne Go.

RLC Residences and its mother company Robinsons Land also received Country Winner recognitions as Best Lifestyle Developer and Best Developer Asia, respectively. Known as one of the real estate giants in the Philippines with decades of experience, Robinsons Land and its residential division RLC Residences have been developing beautiful, well-designed condominiums in the country.

Established in 2005 and considered as the gold standard in the industry, PropertyGuru Asia Property Awards Grand Final gathers the best of the best in the Asia Pacific real estate sector to recognize their best practices and projects.
To learn more about Woodsville Crest and RLC Residences’ other developments, visit rlcresidences.com.
